claim_label: AI Bar Exam Performance vs. Legal Competence
description: GPT-4's performance on the Uniform Bar Exam is significantly lower when evaluated on qualified attorneys rather than the general population.

instances.assertion: GPT-4's performance on the Uniform Bar Exam is significantly lower when evaluated on qualified attorneys rather than the general population.
GPT-4 achieved scores in the top 10% of bar exam test takers, but this does not accurately reflect its ability to practice law.
